reuseLoop.description: ROSTER -> EVENT -> NEW ACTOR -> TOPIC REQUIRED -> save -> reuse from a second EVENT
reuseLoop.mechanismVerificationMethod: Live browser: saved Huiguo (candidate:PCH-001) from EVT-003 via the real Save+Link UI, then invoked the reuse path a second time under a clearly-labeled, non-historical mechanism-check event (excluded from this file's data). Result: person count stayed at 1, only a second link record was added; the possible-match dialog (same name, different candidateId) correctly required an explicit A/B/C human choice rather than auto-merging.
reuseLoop.realDataGap: The current 8-event seed dataset (events.json) does not yet contain a second REAL event that independently requires the same Topic Required person. Each of the 7 topic_candidates is currently referenced by exactly one event. This is a data-coverage gap, not a mechanism gap, and is out of scope for v0.1 (no large-scale new event authoring).
reuseLoop.recommendation: Phase 12 (or later): author one additional, properly sourced real event that legitimately reuses an existing Topic Required person (e.g. a second Huiguo-adjacent Tang-Japan knowledge-transmission event) to close this data-coverage gap with genuine history rather than a synthetic record.
